name: worker-micro-poc
method: vitest browser (Chromium, headless) — 실 WorkerRenderGate + OffscreenCanvas + transferToImageBitmap round-trip. warmup 5 + 30 samples, median.
gpu_status: no-webgl (headless → SwiftShader-class software raster). bitmapMs/mainCommitMs SwiftShader-inflated(신뢰 낮음); packMs/transferMs/workerDrawMs/main-raster CPU(신뢰 높음).

render_cycle_ref.note: worker 재래스터 cadence = 데이터 업데이트(제품 B-real=1s). interaction(hover)은 main overlay라 worker 비트리거.

caveats: workerMainBlocking 은 pack+commit 만 — postMessage 직렬화(main-resident)는 transferMs 안에 섞여 별도 미분리 → workerMainBlocking 은 과소(낙관) 추정.
bitmapMs(8.95/72.4)는 SwiftShader 아티팩트. 실 GPU(Step 0: drawImage 3%)에선 훨씬 작음 → roundtrip 과대.
main-only raster(0.3/2.5ms)도 SwiftShader 영향(실 GPU에선 CPU path-build만) — 절대 TBT 감소량 판정엔 headed 실 GPU 필요.
